1ZMF: Discarding the Ambrosial Nectar, they greedily grab the poison; they serve others, instead of the Lord.
Discarding ambrosia, (the perverse) cling to poison and serve other (than the Lord).
1Q6L: They lose their faith, they have no understanding; night and day, they suffer in pain.
They lose their faith, understand not God and pass night and day in pain.
DM4K: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Lord; they are drowned to death without water. ||1||
The blind wayward think not of the Lord and are drowned to death without water.
RQGC: O mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord; seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.
O my Mind! ever remember God and seek His shelter.
NVN8: If the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides deep within, then you shall not forget the Lord. ||1||Pause||
If Guru's Word abides within your mind, you shall not forget God, then. Pause.
194V: This body is the puppet of Maya. The evil of egotism is within it.
This body is a puppet of mammon. In it is infused the evil ego.
RHQ2: Coming and going through birth and death, the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.
In coming and going, birth and death an apostate loses honour.
1DF8: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light. ||2||
By serving the True Guru man attains to eternal peace and his light merges with the Supreme Light.
WAB8: Serving the True Guru brings a deep and profound peace, and one's desires are fulfilled.
The service of the Sat Guru is extremely ease-bestowing and by it one obtains the boon that he desire.
RJKQ: Abstinence, truthfulness and self-discipline are obtained, and the body is purified; the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within the mind.
By placing Lord God in the mind continence, truthfulness and penance are obtained and the body becomes pure.
GYAH: Such a person remains blissful forever, day and night. Meeting the Beloved, peace is found. ||3||
Such person ever remain happy day and night and procures peace by meeting the Beloved.
5AKS: I am a sacrifice to those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
I am devoted to those, who have sought the protection of the True Guru.
KQSV: In the Court of the True One, they are blessed with true greatness; they are intuitively absorbed into the True Lord.
In the True Court they obtains true honour and are easily absorbed in the True Lord.
RRAP: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace He is found; the Gurmukh is united in His Union. ||4||12||45||
Nanak, through associating with the society of the Exalted Guru one meets the Lord by His grace.
9EPL: The self-willed manmukh performs religious rituals, like the unwanted bride decorating her body.
The performance of rituals by an apostate is like of the bodily decoration of the wife discarded by her husband.
8S1X: Her Husband Lord does not come to her bed; day after day, she grows more and more miserable.
Her Spouse comes not to her couch and she becomes miserable for ever and aye.
VAT1: She does not attain the Mansion of His Presence; she does not find the door to His House. ||1||
She attains not to the presence of her Bridegroom and does not ever see the door of His mansion.
VDYD: O Siblings of Destiny, meditate on the Naam with one-pointed mind.
O Brother! with single mind remember God's Name.
7CL8: Remain united with the Society of the Saints; chant the Name of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||
By remaining united with the society of saints and repeating the Name of God, you attainest peace. Pause.
1NBY: The Gurmukh is the happy and pure soul-bride forever. She keeps her Husband Lord enshrined within her heart.
Ever blissful is the virtuous wife, she keeps her spouse her gait and she enjoys the couch of her spouse.
M73G: Her speech is sweet, and her way of life is humble. She enjoys the Bed of her Husband Lord.
Sweet is her speech humble her gait and she enjoys the couch of her spouse.
P6ZE: The happy and pure soul-bride is noble; she has infinite love for the Guru. ||2||
Praise-worthy and eternally wedded life is of the bride, who bears infinite love to the Guru.
SGQ3: By perfect good fortune, one meets the True Guru, when one's destiny is awakened.
When destiny awakens, man meets the True Guru through the greatest good luck.
1LDU: Suffering and doubt are cut out from within, and peace is obtained.
Suffering and superstition are annulled from within and peace is procured.
373D: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will shall not suffer in pain. ||3||
He who lives according to Guru's will suffers no anguish.
RE7H: The Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, is in the Guru's Will. With intuitive ease, it is obtained.
In the will of the Guru lies ambrosia. Through equipoise hardly any one obtains it.
0ZEY: Those who are destined to have it, drink it in; their egotism is eradicated from within.
They, who are destined to have it, quaff Nectar by rooting out pride from within themselves.
3KVL: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and is united with the True Lord. ||4||13||46||
By remembering the Name through the Guru O Nanak! union with the True Lord is effected.
74CH: If you know that He is your Husband Lord, offer your body and mind to Him.
If you realise, he is your husband, place your body and soul before Him.
SWV7: Behave like the happy and pure soul-bride.
Do you those deeds, which deeds the chastewives do.
3D1E: With intuitive ease, you shall merge with the True Lord, and He shall bless you with true greatness. ||1||
By resignation and faith you shall acquire union with the True One, who shall bestow on you true glory.
YG7S: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.
O Brother! without the Guru, devotional worship of God is not performed.
ZYWA: Without the Guru, devotion is not obtained, even though everyone may long for it. ||1||Pause||
Sans the Guru, Lord's worship cannot be obtained even though all may long for it. Pause.
YBUP: The soul-bride in love with duality goes around the wheel of reincarnation, through 8.4 million incarnations.
Because of another's love the bride goes round in the circuit of eighty-four lakhs of live.
F3LM: Without the Guru, she finds no sleep, and she passes her life-night in pain.
Without the Guru she has no sleep and passes her night in agony.
2QG0: Without the Shabad, she does not find her Husband Lord, and her life wastes away in vain. ||2||
Without Guru's words, the Beloved is not obtained and she loses her life in vain.2

F96R: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.
Practising pride and ego, she wandered about in the world, but wealth and property shall not accompany her.
VMGG: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.
The blind one thinks not of the Name. Every one is bound by the angle of death.
3T8V: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord in the heart. ||3||
By meeting the True Guru, wealth of His Name is obtained and man contemplates over God's Name in his heart.
3ZLU: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, they obtain intuitive peace and poise.
They, who are dyed with God's Name, are spotless. By Guru's grace they are adorned with Divine knowledge.
3WCJ: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tongues savor His Sublime Essence.
Their soul and body are tinctured with Lord's love and their tongue enjoys the Name Nectar.
YY4A: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away. ||4||14||47||
Nanak the love-dye, which God has applied from the very outset, does not wear off.
895P: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without the Guru there is no devotional worship.
If the Exalted Guru shows favour God's worship is performed, without the Guru, Lord's service is not possible.
3MW5: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.
if the Guru unites with his ownself, then the man understands the Lord and becomes pure.
2YZ3: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||
True is the Sire God and True is His Bani. it is through Guru's word that one unites with the Lord.
11NX: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to come into the world?
O Brother! what for has one without meditation come into this world?
M8YD: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||
He has nor performed the service of the Perfect Guru and has wasted his life in vain. Pause.
FP4B: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself.
God, the life of the world Himself, is the Giver of peace and granting pardon, Himself unites the mortal with His ownself.
Y6ZT: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?
What are these helpless creatures? What can any one say and preach?
1NBW: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||
The Lord Himself grants glory to the pious person and Himself puts him to His service.
E862: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, but none will go along with them in the end.
See (O Man!) your family, whose affection has lured you, shall not go with you at your departure.
6VG1: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Value cannot be estimated.
By serving the True Guru I have obtained God, the Treasure of excellences. His worth cannot be appraised.
47F8: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||
Lord God, my comrade and friend and my Master, shall be my helper at the end.
5UMG: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness is not removed.
In the heart of his heart one may say or cause to be said anything but without the Guru self-conceit is not removed.
S36Z: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.
Venerable God, the bestower is the love of devotional service. By bestowing His grace, He abides in man's mind.
8TS8: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48||
Nanak, the Lord Himself confers singing of His praises and spiritual awakening and to the Guru beloved, He grants glory.
QDYH: Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one who serves the True Guru and finds peace.
Blessed is the mother, who bore him and blessed the respectable father of him,
V606: His arrogant pride is banished from within.
who by serving the True Guru has obtained peace and vanished ego from within himself.
UFZQ: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||
Standing at the door of God, the Treasure of virtues, the holy persons serve and obtain Him.
ZAYL: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.
O my soul! through, the Exalted Guru meditate on that God.
LNKE: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||
If Guru's word abide within your soul, your mind and body shall be rendered neat and clean. Pause.
3DRA: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.
Having showered His benediction, my Lord has entered my house and has Himself met me.
3RP6: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color with intuitive ease.
If, by Guru's instruction man sings the praises of God, He automatically dyes him in His love.
GP6G: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, we shall never be separated again. ||2||
Becoming truthful the mortal merges in the True One remains blended with Him and separates not.
JUZF: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.
Whatever the Lord is to do He is doing. No one else can do any thing.
7CQQ: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the True Guru, who takes them into His Own Account.
Taking into his own account the True Guru has united with God, the souls separated since long.
CZAV: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||
He Himself puts mortals to various pursuits. Nothing else can be done.
44AJ: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism and corruption.
He, whose soul and body are imbued with Lord's love, eschews ego and evil.
LHRS: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.
Day and night in His mind he continues repeating the Name of the Fearless and Formless One.
NDZ8: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad. ||4||16||49||
Nanak, He unites his with Himself through the Perfect word of the Infinite.
RQY7: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.
The Lord of the world is the storehouse of merits. His limit cannot be known.3
VQB5: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within.
By words of mouth He is not obtained. He is attained by turning out self-conceit from within.

4GQR: Meeting the True Guru, one is permeated forever with the Fear of God, who Himself comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||
By meeting the True Guru, man ever remains permeated in the fear of Lord who Himself comes and dwells in his mind.
1AAK: O Siblings of Destiny, one who becomes Gurmukh and understands this is very rare.
O Brother! some rare person understands the Truth through the Guru.
DG93: To act without understanding is to lose the treasure of this human life. ||1||Pause||
To attend to temporal affairs without realising the reality is to lose the wealth of human life. Pause.
WLTT: Those who have tasted it, enjoy its flavor; without tasting it, they wander in doubt, lost and deceived.
Who have tasted the Name Nectar, they enjoy its relish. Without tasting it, men go astray in doubt.
WW11: The True Name is the Ambrosial Nectar; no one can describe it.
Ambrosia is the True Name but one can say not its praise.
FZS7: Drinking it in, one becomes honorable, absorbed in the Perfect Word of the Shabad. ||2||
No sooner does the man drink the Name Nectar than he becomes acceptable and gets absorbed in the Perfect Lord.
N91H: He Himself gives, and then we receive. Nothing else can be done.
If God Himself gives we receive Nectar, then, No other effort can be made.
EXLQ: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver. At the Guru's Door, in the Gurdwara, it is received.
The gift is in the hand of the Giver. We receive it at the Guru's Door.
ADK4: Whatever He does, comes to pass. All act according to His Will. ||3||
As the Lord does, so it comes to pass, and accordingly deeds the mortal performs.
FULQ: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is abstinence, truthfulness, and self-restraint. Without the Name, no one becomes pure.
Continence truthfulness and self-restraint are all contained in God's Name. Without the Name man becomes not spotless.
ER8J: Through perfect good fortune, the Naam comes to abide within the mind. Through the Shabad, we merge into Him.
Through perfect good fortune, the Name dwells in the mortal's mind and he attains to the union of the Lord through the Word.
4VSS: O Nanak, one who lives in intuitive peace and poise, imbued with the Lord's Love, obtains the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||17||50||
Nanak, who effortlessly lives in Lord's love, he, obtains the gift of Lord's praises.
4CW5: You may torment your body with extremes of self-discipline, practice intensive meditation and hang upside-down, but your ego will not be eliminated from within.
Man may torment his body and perform penance, with body reversed, his pride would not go from within him.
WFZ8: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
If he performs artificial spiritual rites, he shall never attain to God's Name.
5NSP: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain dead while yet alive, and the Name of the Lord shall come to dwell within the mind. ||1||
The Name of God comes and abides in the mind of him, who under Guru's instruction while alive, remains dead.
W1Q3: Listen, O my mind: hurry to the Protection of the Guru's Sanctuary.
Hearken, O my soul! hasten you to the sanctuary of the True Guru.
QSBB: By Guru's Grace you shall be saved. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's grace, you shall be exonerated. You shall cross the terrible world-ocean of poison by Guru's Word. Pause.
KNEB: Everything under the influence of the three qualities shall perish; the love of duality is corrupting.
Perishable are all the deeds pertaining to the three qualities for in duality is the sin.
BKV8: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read the scriptures, but they are trapped in the bondage of emotional attachment. In love with evil, they do not understand.
Bound with the bonds of worldly love the Pandit reads scriptures and being attached to sin he realises not God.
0BJU: Meeting the Guru, the bondage of the three qualities is cut away, and in the fourth state, the Door of Liberation is attained. ||2||
By meeting the True Guru, man is relieved of the bondage of three qualities and obtains the door of salvation in the fourth state.
49KN: Through the Guru, the Path is found, and the darkness of emotional attachment is dispelled.
Through the Guru, God's way is found and the darkness of temporal love is dispelled.
BRRV: If one dies through the Shabad, then salvation is obtained, and one finds the Door of Liberation.
If man dies by God's Name he is saved then and obtains the door of salvation.
3R2S: By Guru's Grace, one remains blended with the True Name of the Creator. ||3||
By Guru's grace he remains blended with the True Name of the Creator.
XLW0: This mind is very powerful; we cannot escape it just by trying.
This mind is extremely powerful and by no endeavours, what ever, it leaves the man.
7S6P: In the love of duality, people suffer in pain, condemned to terrible punishment.
The mind affects man with the disease of duality and inflicts severe punishment on him.
X68F: O Nanak, those who are attached to the Naam are saved; through the Shabad, their ego is banished. ||4||18||51||
Nanak, they who are attached with Name are saved and God's Name banishes their ego.
6QHD: By His Grace, the Guru is found, and the Name of the Lord is implanted within.
When God shows mercy the Guru is found and he implants God's Name with the man.
F48D: Without the Guru, no one has obtained it; they waste away their lives in vain.
Without the Guru no one has obtained the Name and the man loses his life in vain.
6A1G: The self-willed manmukhs create karma, and in the Court of the Lord, they receive their punishment. ||1||
An apostate does misdeeds and he suffers punishment in Lord's Court.
NR2F: O mind, give up the love of duality.
O my Soul! forsake another's love.
0ZYL: The Lord dwells within you; serving the Guru, you shall find peace. ||Pause||
Within you abides God. Do you attain to peace by serving the Guru. Pause.
FB1A: When you love the Truth, your words are true; they reflect the True Word of the Shabad.
If you embracest love for the True Lord, true shall be your speech and true your faith.
V1A5: The Name of the Lord dwells within the mind; egotism and anger are wiped away.
By abiding God's Name in the mind pride and wrath are wiped off.
W5NP: Meditating on the Naam with a pure mind, the Door of Liberation is found. ||2||
If mortal ponders on the Name with pure mind, then does he reach the door of salvation.
3N97: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. It dies and is re-born; it continues coming and going in reincarnation.
In pride the world perishes. It dies and is reborn and continues coming and going.
GWLR: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize the Shabad; they forfeit their honor, and depart in disgrace.
The perverse recognise not Lord's Name. They depart in disgrace.4
SWX1: Serving the Guru, the Name is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||
By performing the service of the Guru the Name is gained and one remains absorbed in the True Lord.

GX99: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.
By obeying Guru's directive and eradicating self-conceit from within the Great Lord is obtained.
BNLE: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.
Such a person, night and day ever lovingly performs the service of the True One.
1AX0: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52||
The wealth of God's Name abides within his mind and he gets absorbed in the celestial bliss, O Nanak!
VQHA: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.
The persons who serve not the True Guru; they shall be miserable through the four ages.
3NGN: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.
In their home is the Guru-Good, whom they recognise not. They are duped by ego and pride.
JXXR: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.
Accursed by the True Guru, they have grown weary of begging the world over.
80J1: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||
They have meditated not on the True Word, which nicely does all the affairs.
CARK: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.
O my Mind! ever see God just close-by.
HHMM: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||
(Thus) God shall annul your pain of birth and death and you shall remain brimful with His Name. Pause.
WXPC: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.
They alone are true who praise the True Lord and whose sustenance is the True Name.
F6ZA: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.
They do the righteous deeds and bear love to the True Name.
55LF: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.
The writ of the True Banker runs and there is no eraser of it.
UT8C: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||
The wayward attain not the Lord's palace. Those liars are duped by falsehood.
UGSJ: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.
Engrossed in conceit the world is perishing. Without the Guru, there is pitch dark.
UXC3: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.
Attached to mammon the world has forgotten, the Great Bestower, the Dispenser of peace.
AEVG: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.
If it performs the service of the True Guru and keeps the True Being clasped to its heat, it is saved then.
4XLV: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||
By Guru's grace alone we obtain the Lord and reflect on the True World.
9C0R: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.
If you servest the True Guru, your mind becomest pure and you sheldest your ego and evil.
5VJE: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Leave you your self-conceit remain dead though alive and deliberate over Guru's Word.
SYPF: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.
By embracing affection for the True Being the running after worldly pursuits comes to an end.
D40Z: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||
The faces of those who are imbued with Truth Become bright in that True Court.
L0JE: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad
They, who worship not the Divine True Guru and cherish not love for the Word,
YB5F: they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.
in spite of their repeated ablution and almsgiving are ruined by profane love.
GL54: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.
If Sire God shows His mercy then does man come to profess love for the Name.
124H: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||
Through the infinite Love of the Guru, O Nanak! do you meditate on Lord's Name.
ZBB6: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.
Whom shall I serve? What shall I meditate upon? I go and ask the True Guru.
HCY0: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.
I submit to the will of the True Guru and have expelled my self conceit from within me.
H8VN: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.
This is the service and meditation of the Lord by which the Name comes and dwells in my mind.
F8MB: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
Through God's Name alone happiness is obtained and the man is adorned by True Word.
P5MP: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.
My mind, night and day remain wakeful and ponder over God.
2A6C: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||
Protect your crop else the swallow shall descend on the farm. Pause.
GXZQ: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.
He, who is filled with God's Name, has his heart's desires fulfilled.
PYCT: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him always close at hand.
He, who fears, loves and serves the Lord day and night ever sees the Venerable God just close at hand.
HA3M: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.
Doubt flees away from the body of him whose soul ever remains imbued with the True Name.
0DNM: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence. ||2||
He attains to the Immaculate Lord who is True and an Ocean of Excellences.
T7R4: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.
They who remain awake, are saved. They who are asleep, are plundered.
76VD: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fade away.
They recognise not the True Name and their life passes off like a dream.5
L0PA: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come.
Like the guest of a deserted house, as he came so does he go.

VJYE: The life of the self-willed manmukh passes uselessly. What face will he show when he passes beyond? ||3||
The life of an apostate passes away in vain. What face shall he show on arrival before God?
MG2R: God Himself is everything; those who are in their ego cannot even speak of this.
The Lord Himself is all in all. In pride man cannot utter His Name.
P75L: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized, and the pain of egotism is eradicated from within.
Through the Guru's word is He realised and the disease of pride is eradicated from within.
SZ9Y: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru.
I fall at the feet of those who wait upon their own True Guru.
5RQN: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true in the True Court. ||4||21||54||
Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those, who are found true in the True Court.
SAKY: Consider the time and the moment-when should we worship the Lord?
If we think of the suitable time and moment, at what time, then can the worship of Lord be performed?
BQ73: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.
By remaining night and day, imbued with God's Name, the true Person has true reputation.
5CUS: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?
When one Forgets the Beloved even for a moment, what sort of devotional service is that?
DHHG: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of his is wasted. ||1||
One whose soul and body are cool, with the True Name, no breath of his goes in vain.
1LH3: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.
O my soul! meditate on the Name of God.
4R75: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
Then alone the true worship is performed if God comes and dwells within man's mind. Pause.
2BJ7: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.
In mental poise, cultivate the farm and sow the seed of the True Name.
EWF2: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.
The seedlings have luxuriantly sprouted and naturally the mind is well satisfied.

2KN5: With the mind so imbued, and the tongue imbued as well, sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
Your soul shall be imbued, and imbued shall be your tongue with Lord's love, if you sing the praises of the True God.
N0J4: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; immerse yourself in the True One. ||4||31||64||
Nanak, forget not God's Name, and be merged in the True one.
CG24: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, First House:
P5D8: Within my mind and body is the intense pain of separation; how can my Beloved come to meet me in my home?
Within mind and body is an exceedingly great pang of separation, How shall my Beloved come to meet me in my home?
A59X: When I see my God, seeing God Himself, my pain is taken away.
When I see my Lord, by seeing Him, my anguish is ended.
R3H6: I go and ask my friends, "How can I meet and merge with God?" ||1||
I go and ask those friends the way, by which, the Lord is met and introduced?
AP2G: O my True Guru, without You I have no other at all.
O my true Guru! without You, I have none else.
D1QL: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be Merciful and unite me with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
I am foolish and ignorant and have sought yours sanctuary. Take pity on me and unite me with that God. Pause.
CAPG: The True Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord. God Himself causes us to meet Him.
The true Guru is the giver of God's Name, Himself, he causes me to meet the Lord.
XB11: The True Guru understands the Lord God. There is no other as Great as the Guru.
The True Guru has understood the Lord God. None else is as great as the Guru.
5MT8: I have come and collapsed in the Guru's Sanctuary. In His Kindness, He has united me with God. ||2||
I go and fall under Guru's protection. By his grace he unites me with that Lord.0
A0Z3: No one has found Him by stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of the effort.
Through mind's obstinacy none has obtained the Lord. All have grown weary of making efforts.

MDBG: Thousands of clever mental tricks have been tried, but still, the raw and undisciplined mind does not absorb the Color of the Lord's Love.
By adopting thousands of cleverness the mortals have failed. The unimpressionable mind embraces not Lord's love.
HVZW: By falsehood and deception, none have found Him. Whatever you plant, you shall eat. ||3||
Through falsehood and deceit no one has gained God. Whatever one shows that he eats.
ZSAZ: O God, You are the Hope of all. All beings are Yours; You are the Wealth of all.
My master! you are the hope of all. All the beings are Yours and You are their wealth.
W135: O God, none return from You empty-handed; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are praised and acclaimed.
From You, O Lord! none is empty handed. At Your door, the Guru's beloved, get applause.
48UT: In the terrifying world-ocean of poison, people are drowning-please lift them up and save them! This is servant Nanak's humble prayer. ||4||1||65||
Slave Nanak makes an supplication, men are being drowned in the dreadful ocean of vice, do You drag them out.
XHCZ: Receiving the Naam, the mind is satisfied; without the Naam, life is cursed.
By acquiring God's Name, the soul is satiated. Without the Name, accursed is the life.
AX3S: If I meet the Gurmukh, my Spiritual Friend, he will show me God, the Treasure of Excellence.
If I meet some Holy Friends, who points out to me the Lord, the Treasure of virtues.
7N6Q: I am every bit a sacrifice to one who reveals to me the Naam. ||1||
I am quartered to him, who reveals to me the Lord's Name.
PQB6: O my Beloved, I live by meditating on Your Name.
O my Beloved! I live by contemplating over the Name.
5EW4: Without Your Name, my life does not even exist. My True Guru has implanted the Naam within me. ||1||Pause||
Without God's Name, I cannot sustain life. O my True Guru! implant the Name within me. Pause.
Q1KP: The Naam is a Priceless Jewel; it is with the Perfect True Guru.
The Name is an invaluable jewel. It is with the perfect Guru.
K0KJ: When one is enjoined to serve the True Guru, He brings out this Jewel and bestows this enlightenment.
The True Guru brings out and gives the bright jewel Name to him who is attaches to His service.
V6SJ: Blessed, and most fortunate of the very fortunate, are those who come to meet the Guru. ||2||
Blessed and the most fortunate of the very fortunate are they who come to the Guru and meet Him
0EZ7: Those who have not met the Primal Being, the True Guru, are most unfortunate, and are subject to death.
They, who have not met the Divine True Guru are unfortunate and subject to death.
D14L: They wander in reincarnation over and over again, as the most disgusting maggots in manure.
They are goaded into existences over and over again, being made terrible worms, and put into ordure.
UPZD: Do not meet with, or even approach those people, whose hearts are filled with horrible anger. ||3||
Draw not near and in the neighbourhood of those in whose heart is the pariah wrath.
EPTY: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar. The very fortunate ones come to bathe in it.
God- incarnate True Guru, is the pool of Nectar, the fortunate ones come and bath there-in.
J6C6: The filth of many incarnations is washed away, and the Immaculate Naam is implanted within.
Their filth of many births is washed off and the immaculate Name is implanted within them.
2EPK: Servant Nanak has obtained the most exalted state, lovingly attuned to the True Guru. ||4||2||66||
By fixing his attention on the True Guru, servant Nanak has obtained the supreme state (of Bliss).
PBL0: I sing His Glories, I describe His Glories, I speak of His Glories, O my mother.
Lord's praises do I sing, His praises do I blazon and praises do I utter, O my mother!
69NK: The Gurmukhs, my spiritual friends, bestow virtue. Meeting with my spiritual friends, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
The exalted Guru, my friend, is bestower of virtue. By meeting my friend I harp upon God's glories.
D1PQ: The Diamond of the Guru has pierced the diamond of my mind, which is now dyed in the deep crimson color of the Name. ||1||
By meeting (the Guru) diamond (my mind) diamond is pierced and is dyed deep red with God's Name
L4FS: O my Lord of the Universe, singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is satisfied.
O My Lord of the universe! By chanting Yours glories my soul is satiated.
H1CC: Within me is the thirst for the Lord's Name; may the Guru, in His Pleasure, grant it to me. ||1||Pause||
My mind is a-thirst for God's Name. May the Guru be pleased to grant that Name to me. Pause.
JLMY: Let your minds be imbued with His Love, O blessed and fortunate ones. By His Pleasure, the Guru bestows His Gifts.
Tincture your hearts with Lord's love, O you the very fortunate. The Guru shall be pleased to confer on you his gifts.
EERR: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.
I am a sacrifice to the True Guru who with love implants God's Name with me.
VAFL: Without the True Guru, the Name of the Lord is not found, even though people may perform hundreds of thousands, even millions of rituals. ||2||
Without the True Guru, God's Name is not found, even though man may perform lakhs and millions of ceremonies.
PBCP: Without destiny, the True Guru is not found, even though He sits within the home of our own inner being, always near and close at hand.
Without Destiny the True Guru is not found even you one sittest daily near and close to Him in his home.
4SFB: There is ignorance within, and the pain of doubt, like a separating screen.
Within is the pain of ignorance and superstition. Between the man and the Lord lies separating screen.
BY50: Without meeting with the True Guru, no one is transformed into gold. The self-willed manmukh sinks like iron, while the boat is very close. ||3||
Without meeting the True Guru, man becomes not gold. An apostate sinks like iron while the boat is just close by.
R95C: The Boat of the True Guru is the Name of the Lord. How can we climb on board?
The ship of the True Guru is the Name of God. In what way can mortal embark there on?
AW77: One who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will comes to sit in this Boat.
He, who acts according to True Guru's Will, comes and sits in the ship.
1YPT: Blessed, blessed are those very fortunate ones, O Nanak, who are united with the Lord through the True Guru. ||4||3||67||
Hail, hail to the greatly fortunate persons, whom the True Guru blends with God, O Nanak!1
